project_overview.agency_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), St. Paul District
project_overview.office_location: 332 Minnesota Street, Suite E1500, St. Paul, MN 55101-1323
project_overview.purpose: To establish, monitor, and maintain native forest habitat as environmental mitigation for the Fargo-Moorhead Metropolitan Flood Risk Management Project (FMM Project).

in_summary.they_want: A contractor to perform site preparation, native tree and forb planting, invasive species control, and three years of habitat maintenance and monitoring services across approximately 165.4 acres, with an option for an additional 10.4 acres.
in_summary.time_frame: Date of contract award through 31 December 2028.
in_summary.delivery_locations: Multiple designated sites located in Cass County, North Dakota and Clay County, Minnesota.

work_locations.description: Floodplain forest planting (5.2 acres), Oak savanna planting (6.5 acres), and Forest preservation (17.2 acres).

Floodplain forest planting (11.7 acres), Oak savanna planting (11.8 acres), and Forest preservation (5.5 acres).

scope_categories.description: Prepare sites for planting, including mowing, broadcast herbicide spray, discing, and burning to establish Floodplain Forest, Bank Stabilization, and Oak Savanna areas.
Plant native trees, live stakes, and seed mixes across three distinct zones: Bank Stabilization (0.3 acres), Floodplain Forest (47.1 acres), and Oak Savanna (21.4 acres).
Control woody and herbaceous invasive species within 96.5 acres of designated Forest Preservation areas using a combination of mechanical and chemical methods.
Conduct 3 years of site maintenance (mowing, spraying, anti-herbivory measures) and annual vegetation monitoring to ensure performance standards are met. Submit annual monitoring reports.
Place approximately 30 boulders to block vehicular access at the entrance to Site 38b prior to contract expiration.

deliverables.format: Draft: MS Word; Final: Digital PDF

deliverables.name: Seed Substitutions
deliverables.due_days: Not later than 30 days prior to seeding

deliverables.name: Noxious and Invasive Species Control Plan

acceptance_criteria: A site walk-through will be conducted with the Contracting Officer in Year 3, early enough to allow for correction of any identified deficiencies.
The site will be accepted after the Contracting Officer approves all repairs and confirms final performance standards are met.
Acceptance will not occur prior to the end of the growing season in Year 3.

Final Performance Standards (Year 3): Achieve specific seedling densities per acre (>450 for floodplain, >300 for savanna), height requirements (>30" and >42"), invasive species limits (<25 woody stems/acre, <15% herbaceous cover), and be free of noxious weeds.

attachment_summaries.Attachment 1 (Deliverables): A schedule of 13 required submittals, including Project Schedule, Safety Plan, Herbicide Plan, Quality Control Plan, Planting Plans, and annual Monitoring Reports, with due dates and required formats.
attachment_summaries.Attachment 2 (Technical Lists): A list of Government-approved herbicides for use on the project. Examples include: Glyphosate, Triclopyr, Imazapyr, 2,4-D + Dicamba, and Clopyralid.
attachment_summaries.Attachment 3 (Forms): A sample 'Herbicide Post-Application Documentation Form' to be completed by the contractor after each application, detailing date, location, target pest, chemical used, and application rate.
attachment_summaries.Attachment 4 (Site Maps/Layouts): A mapbook of the contract sites. Detailed site information is provided in the PWS, including: Site 8a (Clay Co, MN - Floodplain, Savanna, Preservation), Site 32 (Cass Co, ND - Floodplain, Savanna, Preservation), and Site 34 (Cass Co, ND - Floodplain, Bank Stabilization, Preservation).
attachment_summaries.Attachments 5-6: Not included in the provided solicitation package.
